FN-9K1FBP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 404
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Thomas Jackson
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/09/2023
House Bill 404 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency by an undetermined amount to issue or renew a Hazardous Materials Endorsement to a
commercial driver, if the driver holds a valid Transportation Worker Identification Credential
issued by the Transportation Security Administration.
